0.2.119.en: Add X1S support (untested — shares the X2 binary protocol); update app description to clarify no MQTT broker required

0.2.118.en: Fix Stop Activity flow card timeout; fix duplicate devices and missing RF type when SofaBaton app is also open; fix WiFi device creation (always uses HTTP callbacks); fix Manage page delete buttons; debug logging now opt-in via device settings

0.2.103.en: Fix activity and device names: correct UTF-16 offset confirmed from protocol captures

0.2.101.en: Fix activity and device names: scan for longest UTF-16 run to handle variable header padding

0.2.100.en: Fix activity and device names duplicating (stop at null terminator)

0.2.99.en: Fix activity and device names showing a garbage first character

0.2.98.en: Add MQTT requirement hint to activity-changed Flow trigger card

0.2.93.en: Fix proxy mDNS announcing X1 on first boot by persisting hub model opcode across restarts

0.2.92.en: Fix activity-changed Flow trigger not firing over TCP connection

0.2.91.en: Fix settings page spinning forever on some Homey app versions

0.2.90.en: Fix proxy mDNS announcing hub as X1 instead of X2, restoring full device-add options in the SofaBaton app

0.2.120.en: App store cert fixes: driver icon (vector SVG), pairing view shows clear success/failure messages, Manage page token uses sessionStorage

0.2.121.en: Fix Homey App store standards for appid,readme,and logo.

0.2.122.en: Fix crash when device is deleted while a reconnect timer is running

0.2.123.en: Fixed app crash after deleting device.

0.2.127.en: Fix WiFi device buttons not appearing in Flow; fix delete from Hub Device List not persisting; fix crash guards on all connection callbacks

0.2.155.en: Reject broadcast/network addresses (.0 and .255) in hub IP field during pairing and in device settings — prevents the 'TCP callback timeout' error caused by entering 192.168.x.255 instead of the hub's real IP

0.2.154.en: Fix ECONNRESET crash: add request error handler so browser closing the Manage page mid-request no longer crashes the app; add permanent error handlers on the HTTP server and proxy UDP sockets

0.2.153.en: Add 'The current activity was stopped' Flow trigger — fires when the X2 OFF button or app stops the active activity; tokens carry the stopped activity name and ID

0.2.152.en: Add commands to an existing WiFi device without recreating it — use the new Edit button on each device card in Manage page

0.2.151.en: Add button press events (MQTT and HTTP) and trigger outcome to the debug log buffer so they appear in the Manage page Logs tab when debug logging is enabled

0.2.150.en: Fix Flow button filter not matching WiFi device buttons (autocomplete was showing IR/RF catalog command IDs instead of WiFi indices); increase catalog fetch timeouts to fix incomplete activity and command counts on hubs with many devices

0.2.149.en: Fix crash (TypeError: Assignment to constant variable) when a WiFi device button fires via the name-based callback URL and the device is not yet locally registered

0.2.148.en: Fix WiFi device buttons missing from Flow trigger dropdown; fix WiFi button presses not firing Flows; fix Hub Device List delete buttons (confirmation, status feedback, correct cleanup of duplicate entries); prevent duplicate hub devices being re-created on reconnect; fix stale activity catalog on startup; gate verbose logging behind the debug logging setting
